title: oodar
content:
## What it is

The Gen 1 C host substrate. Compiled openOODA binaries link against the `chs_rt_*` symbols at build time and call them at runtime. Capability tokens, Landlock sandbox, linear arenas, PQC primitives, OS shims, FFI glue, and GPU dispatch — all in C, with zero ambient authority.

Extracted from `ooda/runtime/` on 2026-09-03. The M-code agent is the current maintainer.

## Install

```
# link against libchs_rt when building from source
ooda build --target=c99 --link-runtime=oodar
```

The runtime is a C library. Compiled `.oo` programs link against it via the auto-generated header. The install path is via your distro's package manager or the C runtime tarball.

## Surface

The 9 runtime subsystems:

| Subsystem | Symbol prefix | Files | What it does |
|-----------|---------------|-------|--------------|
| Capability tokens | `cap`, `caps`, `weak` | 3 | The 14 OCap tokens + weak-cap composition |
| Landlock sandbox | `landlock`, `sandbox`, `proc_mem` | 3 | Linux Landlock policy + process isolation |
| Linear arena + ARC | `arena`, `alloc` | 2 | Deterministic arena allocation |
| PQC + constant-time | `mldsa`, `mlkem`, `pq_sig` | 3 + `dudect` | Post-quantum crypto + dudect timing tests |
| OS shims | `fs`, `netfloor`, `thread`, `sys`, `host` | 5 | Filesystem, networking, threads, syscalls |
| FFI + xlang | `ffi`, `ffi_sec`, `xlang`, `closure` | 4 | Foreign function interface + cross-language glue |
| GPU dispatch | `gpu`, `gpu_hip` | 2 + 1 .hip | GPU kernel dispatch (CUDA + HIP) |
| Container primitives | `str`, `list`, `llist` | 3 | String, list, linked list primitives |
| Cycles, metrics, time | `cycle`, `metrics`, `time_rand` | 3 | CPU cycles, metrics, secure time |
